buildCommand: corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/heartloom build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src='artifacts/heartloom/dist/public'; const dest='public'; if(fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.rmSync(dest, {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive:true}); console.log('Built output copied to public/');"
